prompt: A vertical 9:16 photograph taken from outside a ground-floor flat at dusk, standing on the pavement close to a single white uPVC window set in dark red-brown brick, the window filling most of the frame with a strip of rough brick and a concrete sill around it. Through slightly dirty, rain-speckled glass and half-open cream vertical blinds, a woman in her late seventies is seen side-on in a dark buttoned coat and a knitted hat, sitting very still in an armchair, lit only by the cold flickering grey light of a television just out of view inside the room; a bare ceiling bulb is switched off above her. Her face is lined, her grey hair uneven where it comes out under the hat. The outside light is a deep, even, slate-blue overcast twilight that tints the white window frame violet at its edges, and the brick is almost colourless. The image is soft and a little smeared, as from a phone night shot with heavy noise reduction, low contrast, lifted blacks, the only warmth a faint orange from a streetlamp reflected in one corner of the glass. Quiet and watched from outside. Thanks.
